headline: Regis keep pace with unbeaten CSU Pueblo
dek: Regis won at Adams State for their ninth win of the season, and have now conceded ten goals, as many as CSU Pueblo, the one side above them in the table. Regis travel to Fort Lewis next, and CSU Pueblo to UCCS.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: South Dakota Mines have scored more goals than Colorado School of Mines and Adams State together, but have also conceded 28; scoring is not what separates the top of the table.

wire.line: CSU Pueblo are the last unbeaten side in the conference after UCCS lost at Colorado Mesa.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day; none is a score gap.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines have yet to win this season, with three draws and thirteen defeats, the latest at CSU Pueblo.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Adams State have scored eight goals this season and conceded 46.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: CSU Pueblo's Nick Cenek has eleven goals and four assists this season, from 53 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UCCS's Hugo Sjöberg has made 61 saves this season and conceded 14 goals.

last_match.line: Since conference play opened, Westminster have lost only to CSU Pueblo, Regis and Fort Lewis; MSU Denver have yet to draw in that time.

next_match.line: Since conference play opened, Fort Lewis have lost only to UCCS and CSU Pueblo; Regis have not lost since UCCS beat them.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
